description: Select one candidate from a finished compose/consult ensemble as the project's saved composition (whole-candidate replace). Body REQUIRES both fields: { candidateIndex, selectStrategy: "agent-authoritative" } — candidateIndex from wait_job(kind="consult") proposals (mode=amend) or the compose winner report; selectStrategy is required and API keys must use 'agent-authoritative' (editor-merge/editor-replace need an editor-session token and 403 on an API key). agent-authoritative replaces the saved composition unconditionally and ignores ifMatch, so read get_composition first and adopt only when no edit made since the consult or compose must survive. After selecting, render with create_render.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.
